At Mercury, we’re building banking* for ambitious companies. More than 450,000 businesses use Mercury to manage their finances. In May 2026, we raised $200 million at a $5.2 billion valuation. By then, we’d reached $650 million in annualized revenue and had been profitable for four years.
 Sales Development has helped Mercury reach startup founders from their earliest days. As we grow, we’re taking on a new challenge alongside that work. How we earn a conversation with a founder who just raised funding looks different from how we earn one with the owner of an established agency. We’re looking for a Manager, Sales Development who’s excited to help us figure that out and coach a team to do it well.
 You’ll hire and develop SDRs, own your team’s pipeline goals, and partner with Account Executives to understand which conversations turn into customers and why. One week, you might coach a rep through a cold call that keeps stalling at the same objection. The next, you might take a message that’s opening doors for one SDR and test whether it works across an entire segment. As the team grows, the people you develop and the playbooks you build will shape how Mercury reaches its next customers.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Ramp is building a new AI business, and you’ll be one of its first technical sellers. Your job is to turn technically complex AI products into closed revenue.
You’ll sell a growing portfolio spanning AI-powered applications and agents for finance teams, as well as infrastructure that helps companies deploy and manage AI with greater control, security, and cost efficiency.
